push the unfulfilled record back on the list

host_steps.contract: ECX = ESI = the record, immediately before 0094C7F8 free.

host_steps.contract: reached when 0094851B TEST AL,AL / 0094851D JZ says the class is not kind 6.

a kind-6 member after the first joins the first created entity's formation

host_steps.contract: ECX = EDI = record+CCh; the in-place arm is 00948742.

allocate, construct and link the request record

corrections.was: record+C0h is a byte, always zero
corrections.is: record+C0h is the fulfilled flag: the constructor clears it and the creator sets it
corrections.evidence: 009487AD MOV byte ptr [EBX + 0xc0],0x1, the last store in 009483D0 before its epilogue; read back at 0094C5A7 CMP byte ptr [ESI + 0xc0],BL with the JZ at 0094C5AD taking the requeue path

corrections.was: record+C4h is the party and record+C8h is the player
corrections.is: record+C4h is the completion callback's function pointer and record+C8h its context word; the party is record+80h
corrections.evidence: 0094C532/0094C542 index game+18CCh + record+80h*4; 0094C7D9 MOV ECX,dword ptr [ESI + 0x80] passes the party to the callback; 0094C777 CMP dword ptr [ESI + 0xc4],0 skips the whole walk when +C4h is null and 0094C7D2/0094C7DF load and call it

corrections.was: angleRange keeps the defaults 200.0 and 2500.0, both ranges are read at slot 0 then slot 1, and angleRange's first element is clamped to at least 10.0
corrections.is: the defaults and the clamp belong to distRange; both ranges are read at Lua indices 1 and 2; angleRange has no absence test, no default and no clamp
corrections.evidence: 00949D69/00949D77 load 00D19908 (00 00 48 43 = 200.0f) and 00D1990C (00 40 1c 45 = 2500.0f) after the distRange key push at 00949D50 and inside the arm 00949D95 CALL 00B65FB0 / 00949D9C JNZ selects; the indices are 00949CDA PUSH 0x1 and 00949D19 PUSH 0x2 for angleRange, 00949D9E and 00949DD4 for distRange; the clamp is 00949E0A MOVSS XMM0,[00CE38B8] / 00949E12 COMISS / 00949E21 JA

corrections.is: SpawnNew queues a spawn request that names its own units, position and callback; 00A38DA0 is in neither the enqueue nor the drain chain and 00946FC0 is a planner-side reader, not the consumer
